Name: Ridgeside Village Items Cometkins Style
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
As previously stated, the mod visuals are completely configurable. If you don't like the way a certain item looks or if it's overriding a different visual mod, simply turn it off in the config.

To make most of these retextures, I used assets from Cometkins's various mods as the basis for the objects. The frog retexture is based on the frog from Silkylamb's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29448]better crops and foraging for SVE - cometkins style[/url] so that SVE users have a better experience. For the Golden Rosefin, I directly ripped the Dorado visual asset from Danekokun's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13136]Fish and Aquarium reskin for -Better Fishing and Beach Foraging-[/url], since Cometkins's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915]Better Fishing and Beach Foraging[/url] has an updated look for the Dorado. This way, fans of the old Dorado version can still have it in the form of the Golden Rosefin.

The Cardia Septal Jellyfish is the only object not really based on Cometkins's style, but it is edited to be more desaturated. If I have the time, I might edit it in the future so that it's more in line with Cometkins's style.

All credit goes to Cometkins for the original inspiration and visual assets.

Shout out to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194160197-passersby10086/]passersby10086[/url] for creating an i18n for my mod. Thanks for the help! Also, anyone can freely translate this mod if they wish to do so.
